_note: 2026-10-17: no verifiable ground photo; a labelled Esri World Imagery satellite view is published instead.

iqa-sat-1.webp.zh: 在卫星图上，阿萨德空军基地（IQA）与周围的干旱地表与裸地连成一片。
iqa-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, Al Asad Air Base (IQA) blends into the surrounding dry ground and bare land.

iqa-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰，一排排战斗机整齐停放在沙漠机坪上，跑道与白色场道建筑延伸向远处。
iqa-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Seen from the air, rows of fighter aircraft sit on a desert apron, runways and pale base buildings stretching toward the horizon.

iqa-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 夕阳下的沙漠营地被一道道防爆墙分成街区，前景是白色顶棚的大机库，远处露出农田。
iqa-chatgpt-02.webp.en: At sunset the desert base is divided into blocks by blast walls, a large white-roofed hangar in the foreground and farmland far beyond.

iqa-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架灰色 F-16 战斗机停在混凝土机堡前，座舱盖打开，细雨正从拱顶外落下。
iqa-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A grey F-16 fighter rests in the mouth of a concrete hardened shelter, its canopy raised while light rain falls beyond the arch.

iqa-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 身穿沙漠迷彩的地勤人员在跑道上清理接缝，旁边停着白色清扫车与黄色空压机。
iqa-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Ground crew in desert camouflage work on runway joints beside a white sweeper and a yellow compressor under a bright cloudy sky.

iqa-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 日落时分，两架双旋翼直升机停在机坪上，一名机务站在机顶检查旋翼，机身只剩剪影。
iqa-chatgpt-05.webp.en: At sunset two tandem-rotor helicopters stand on the apron, a crew member working atop one while the airframes fall into silhouette.

iqa-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 白色小型运输机停在机坪上，后舱门放下登机梯，几名军人从旁走过并向机上敬礼。
iqa-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A small white transport aircraft waits on the apron with its rear stairs down as soldiers walk past and one salutes.

iqa-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 航拍下的沙漠基地铺满拱形帐篷与车辆，一条跑道从营地后方笔直穿过荒地。
iqa-chatgpt-07.webp.en: From the air the desert base spreads out in rows of arched tents and parked vehicles, a runway cutting across the empty ground behind.
